## Summary of the Exact vs. Fuzzy Distinction

- **Fuzzy/contextual matches**: The scenario records are search hits whose text *contains* the name "Bandit Scout" in a monster list. Their snippets are summaries, not full scenario data. No scenario record was opened, so only the snippet-level data (name, number, reward, unlock, monster list) was retrieved for those entries — no map, room, or encounter details.
